about: The local model server addresses Search refuses and takes (design 2026-10-26-local-search, S9). The refused list is the event service's judge-setup list for a local-endpoint judge (packages/events-daemon/test/judge-setup.test.ts, 'judge setup refuses a local model server that is not on this machine'), word for word, plus the forms a URL parser would tidy into a loopback address; search-guards.test.ts checks the event service's list is still in here.
